svg.title: KurtShape concept mockup: Main workspace · ambitious direction
svg.desc: Concept mockup, not a screenshot. Adds a right view rail with quality presets, document-row state chips, part cards with color and a compact NaviCube; viewport loses 40 px on the right.

g.text: End of history · drag to roll back
Click a part to select · right-click to make it the target
CONCEPT MOCKUP · not a screenshot of implemented behavior
Adds a right view rail with quality presets, document-row state chips, part cards with color and a compact NaviCube; viewport loses 40 px on the right.
22 px icons at a 36 px pitch in one lighter-stroke family; the active context family (here Modify) is tinted blue when a tool is armed.
Document row carries Saved/Unsaved and Build state chips beside the name, so model truth is readable without reading the status bar.
Parts as cards with color swatches (per-part appearance) and an explicit Active chip; selecting a part never changes the target.
Right view rail: fit, iso, normal, section, measure, check; a Quality preset popover (Draft/Standard/Present) with its real parameter summary.
Background jobs (geometry check, STEP export) show a progress bar in the status bar; Messages shows an unread dot and count.
Compact 58 px NaviCube with a home glyph; drawn in chrome grays so it recedes.
Material response: cool-gray default ShapeAppearance with lower shininess (session-only satin preset), thinner dark-gray edges
(DefaultShapeLineWidth per DPI) and MSAA 8x in Presentation: all native parameters; no lighting change is assumed.
Selection chip names what is selected (feature · element · geometry type) so picks are verifiable without reading the native tree.
